cause: Boolean mapping mixed local numeric SID domains: some paths switched output hashers after populating names or discarded foreign retention references without translating encoded names. Modified/generated histories and compound child-map shortcuts require normalization before mapping, not just at assignment.

fix.normalization: Import foreign naming graphs into the selected output domain before unchanged-element, modified/generated, copy and compound mapping. Fresh TopoShape caches preserve source metadata and exact OCCT shape identity/location for history queries; geometry is not copied or altered by normalization.
fix.graph_import: Clone complete ElementMap DAGs, aliases, child postfixes and pointer-bearing caches. Recursively import dependencies before parents, preserve SID indices and opaque bytes, memoize shared identities, and detect cycles. Parse native reference grammar rather than replacing arbitrary #hex text; preserve literal Seed#1 operation labels and update native operation-length fields after ID-width changes. Retain dependencies parsed from tagged aggregate leaves.
fix.interning: Identity keys include encoding flags and ordered same-table core dependency IDs, not merely raw payload/postfix. Mutable lifetime flags, owner pointers and reference indices are excluded; retention indices are not part of the existing persistent graph format.
fix.opaque_persistence_FreeCAD_adz: Write binary/hashed leaves as Base64, matching the existing reader; preserve literal indexed type prefixes at low hashing thresholds. No file-format change. Older installed+150 independently changed all8 SHA1 leaf payloads on same-primary-hasher save/cold reopen; threshold0 control passed. This fix prevents new corruption but cannot reconstruct preimages already lost in old files.
